name: mimecast-mcp
description: Find a held or blocked Mimecast message, explain why in one verdict, and release it behind a safety check, with hold-queue triage, mail-flow health and phish click tracing built in.

mimecast_client_id.title: MIMECAST_CLIENT_ID
mimecast_client_id.description: Client ID of your Mimecast API 2.0 application (Administration Console: Administration > Services > API and Platform Integrations > Mimecast API 2.0).

mimecast_client_secret.title: MIMECAST_CLIENT_SECRET
mimecast_client_secret.description: Client secret of your Mimecast API 2.0 application (Administration Console: Administration > Services > API and Platform Integrations > Mimecast API 2.0).

mimecast_account_code.title: Delegated account code (optional)
mimecast_account_code.description: Optional. Mimecast delegate access: the customer account code to act on, sent on the classic endpoints (hold queue, tracking, logs, managed senders). Leave blank to use the API application's own account.

mimecast_base_url.title: API base URL (optional)
mimecast_base_url.description: Optional. Regional API gateway for data residency, for example https://uk-api.services.mimecast.com. Set MIMECAST_TOKEN_URL to the same region. Leave blank for https://api.services.mimecast.com.

mimecast_token_url.title: OAuth token URL (optional)
mimecast_token_url.description: Optional. Regional OAuth token endpoint, for example https://uk-api.services.mimecast.com/oauth/token. Leave blank for https://api.services.mimecast.com/oauth/token.

mimecast_oauth_scope.title: OAuth scope (optional)
mimecast_oauth_scope.description: Optional. OAuth scope sent with the client-credentials token request. Leave blank to send no scope.

mimecast_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
mimecast_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to Mimecast. Leave blank to use the built-in one.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Optional. Binds the MCP server to one saved client profile. Leave blank for the default.

mimecast_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
mimecast_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

mimecast_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
mimecast_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and nothing is written to the local store. Leave blank to keep the local store.

mimecast_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
mimecast_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
